options.label: B
options.textMd: Form must not be in position 1.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Memo must not be in position 1.

explanationMd:
Combine the ordering and placement constraints rather than assuming one example is unique. The statement "Memo must not be in position 1." holds in all 10 permitted orders. Generate the cases by placing any fixed-position item and adjacent block first, then discard arrangements that violate a remaining rule. For each alternative, an explicit permitted counterexample appears in its feedback.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Form → Letter → Notice → Report → Memo
- Form → Notice → Letter → Report → Memo
- Letter → Form → Memo → Notice → Report
- Letter → Form → Notice → Memo → Report
- Letter → Report → Memo → Notice → Form
- Letter → Report → Notice → Memo → Form
- Notice → Form → Letter → Memo → Report
- Notice → Report → Letter → Memo → Form
- Report → Letter → Notice → Form → Memo
- Report → Notice → Letter → Form → Memo

distractorRationale.b: A counterexample satisfying all the rules is Form → Letter → Notice → Report → Memo. Thus this statement is not necessary.
distractorRationale.c: A counterexample satisfying all the rules is Form → Letter → Notice → Report → Memo. Thus this statement is not necessary.
distractorRationale.a: A counterexample satisfying all the rules is Letter → Form → Memo → Notice → Report. Thus this statement is not necessary.
